mechanism: Tretinoin increases skin irritation and photosensitivity while prednisolone may mask inflammatory responses and impair local immune function, potentially increasing risk of adverse dermatologic effects if tretinoin is used systemically or in proximity to treated ocular area.
action: Monitor for increased skin irritation if tretinoin is used concurrently; counsel patient on sun protection and consider timing of application away from eye area; use lowest effective prednisolone dose and duration.
